No GraphQL schema is defined. The public API is protobuf-defined gRPC, exposed through the gRPC-Gateway and Connect handlers; for example, [proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto](/bench/repo/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto) defines the memo RPCs and [server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64](/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go#L64) registers their HTTP-facing gateway.
